reading.title: Giving Directions 1: Finding an Appointment
reading.text: Nora follows the instructions: go forward, turn left, then go straight. A right turn leads elsewhere. She does not walk backward. Inside, she goes up in a lift, then down to reception and stops. The town map shows north and south, east and west. The library is northeast of the station.

reading.title: Giving Directions 2: Finding an Appointment
reading.text: Nora uses a compass to check her direction. The park is northwest of the station, the office southeast and the school southwest. Her keys are somewhere in her bag, nowhere on the bench.
